intent_sections.title: Search Console Query Flow Verified
intent_sections.summary: The operator can enter a query, watch the console move from idle to loading, and read a ranked list of matches. Ranking order and the states the operator can tell apart were each verified against a captured artifact.

intent_sections.title: Narrow Viewport Floor Is Not Evidenceable In This Harness
intent_sections.summary: The declared verification harness renders the console without a layout engine, so it measures no element geometry at all and reports the same tree at every viewport width. Whether the result list stays inside a 360 pixel floor without overflowing was therefore not verified in the automated run.
intent_sections.alternative_verification: The result list was opened once by hand in a real browser at a 360 pixel width and read for overflow, and a browser based visual check is queued for the next slice so this stops being manual.

intent_sections.title: Search Boundary Latency Above the Client Guard
intent_sections.summary: A search that takes longer than three seconds trips the client timeout guard and the console returns to idle rather than hanging. The boundary itself is not rate limited, so a slow index is the only way this fires.
intent_sections.mitigation: The timeout guard is the invariant under watch. If the boundary starts to exceed it in normal use, the deadline belongs in the scenario matrix as a branch rather than as a guard.
